name: onegoodarea
description: Ask about any neighbourhood in England, Wales or Scotland and get what the area is like, a score for your purpose, and alerts when it changes. Every answer names its public source, the date it describes and how confident it is.

interface.longDescription:
OneGoodArea tells you what any neighbourhood in England, Wales or Scotland is like. Give it a postcode, a place name or an official area code and it returns the schools, crime, property prices, transport, amenities, flood risk and deprivation for that place, each with the public source it came from, the period it describes and a confidence level.

Ask for a score and it rates the place out of 100 for your purpose: a family move, a business location, an investment or general research, with the seven dimensions behind the number explained. Compare several places in one table, find the places most like one you already know, read a brief written for a lender, an investor or a retailer, or watch a list of places and be told when the data about them moves and why.

It is built for people who work with property and places: analysts, lenders, agents, investors, retailers and the teams building property and location products. Sign in with a OneGoodArea account.

Limits: coverage is England, Wales and Scotland, not Northern Ireland. Property figures are sale prices, not rents. Scores are deterministic and versioned, so the same question gives the same answer until the methodology changes, and the version is stamped on every response.
capabilities: Resolve a postcode, place name or area code to a permanent place
Describe a neighbourhood with sourced, dated signals
Score a place out of 100 for a stated purpose
Compare several places in one table
Find places similar to a place you know
Watch places and report what changed and why
Explain the scoring methodology and its version
defaultPrompt: Score M1 1AE for opening a shop
Compare M1 1AE, SW4 0LG and EH1 1BB for investing

positive.description: Resolve a live postcode to its permanent place
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the postcode as live, the neighbourhood Southwark 022E in England, and a place id starting oga_pl_.

positive.description: Score a place for a business decision
positive.prompt: Score M1 1AE for opening a shop
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a score from 0 to 100 on the business preset, seven dimensions each with a confidence level, a short summary and the engine version.

positive.prompt: Compare M1 1AE, SW4 0LG and EH1 1BB for investing
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one table sorted by score with all three places present, including the Scottish postcode.

positive.prompt: Give me a lender brief on SW1A 1AA
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a brief with verdict, affordability, risk and value sections, each citing its public sources and dates.

positive.description: Explain the methodology without a data call
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the crime dimension, its weight and its sources from the published methodology; no place data is fetched.

negative.description: Northern Ireland is outside coverage; no score may be invented
An unknown postcode is reported as unknown; the assistant does not guess a place
Rents are not held; the assistant says so and offers the sale-price signals instead of a rent figure
negative.prompt: What is the rent for a two-bed flat in E1 6AN?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First listing. OneGoodArea engine 1.12.6, MCP server hosted at api.onegoodarea.com/mcp. Twelve tools: resolve_place, score_postcode, compare_postcodes, get_area_signals, get_signals_by_category, find_areas, find_peers, watch_portfolio, get_portfolio_changes, area_brief, methodology_for, engine_version. Coverage England, Wales and Scotland. Sign in with a OneGoodArea account. Training capture off by default.
